Maya R.: Morning! Left a surprise 'Thank You' snack + sticker box in the 6th-floor kitchen for everyone who rallied on the weekend deploy. Big shout to Samir and Priya for holding the line :tada: 

Aj: Love that — Samir did a heroic rollback patch. Also Eli and Priya stayed on until 2am. absolute champs. :clap: 

Samir: oh wow, didn't expect the box. team effort all around. quick log from the fix: ```ERROR: OOM at allocate 4.2GB -> cleared cache -> retry -> success``` 

Eli: legit — had to nuke a bad cache entry and force the canary to rehydrate. glad that worked :sunglasses: 

Priya: QA late-night testing paid off. also left homemade brownies next to the box :brown_heart: (help yourselves) 

CoffeeBot: :coffee: Inventory update — snacks remaining: 2 brownies, 8 granola bars, 1 sticker sheet. 

Maya R.: who wants celebratory tacos tomorrow? vote with emoji — :taco: = yes, :no_entry_sign: = nope 

Aj: :taco: 

Samir: :taco: 

Eli: :taco: 

Priya: :raised_hands: also, can someone mirror this to #people-ops so we can log the small spot bonus and kudos? 

Maya R.: will do. filing now. thanks again everyone — couldn't have shipped this without you. /me sneaks the last brownie :sneaky: 

(Reaction summary: :tada: x5, :heart: x3, :taco: x4)
